verdict.rationale: The docs describe a CLI and MCP interface that is scriptable and can be invoked by cron or agents, but there is no evidence of any bulk/batch endpoint or command that operates across many items (tasks, projects, intentions) at once — each described flow (claim task, approve contract, submit feedback) is single-item. Missing for 10: any documented bulk-create/bulk-approve command, batch API endpoint, or example of processing multiple items in one call.
